slots.name: arch height
slots.sentence: Trump’s proposed 250-foot triumphal arch is moving closer to construction after the Interior Department announced Thursday that excavation at the site will begin within the next two weeks.

slots.name: lawsuit status
slots.sentence: Three Vietnam War veterans sued the Trump administration to block the construction of the arch earlier this year, citing the lack of congressional approval and concerns that it would obstruct the view of the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery.
